header: THE SAVED CONSUMER PRICE INDEX (table public.cpi_month, src/lib/nl2sql/sql/23_cpi_month.sql): MoSPI's index and inflation rate for each month, State and sector, with the time received. I build the card from these rows, and ask MoSPI only for a month that is not saved yet, so the card keeps working when MoSPI's service is down, and a month once published stays. Nothing here may break a card: database trouble is logged once and the store then answers "nothing saved" (all) or does nothing (put). I followed the pattern of src/lib/live/fareStore.ts here.

doc: Reads a saved row back and CHECKS it: a row that is not the shape written is dropped, never shown.

behaviours: rows are written and read back as they were (a missing rate stays null)
the table is made once, with row-level security
a month received again replaces the saved one, never doubles it
a thousand rows go in batches of at most 400 (3 statements)
a row that is not the shape written is not shown
a database that cannot make the table: nothing saved, nothing thrown
a read that fails answers nothing saved
a write that fails does not throw
